item.title: US Democrats nominate Hakeem Jeffries to be first Black speaker of the House
item.description: Democrats nominated Hakeem Jeffries on Wednesday to be the next speaker of the House of Representatives, putting him on track to make history as the nation’s first Black American with the gavel.

item.title: French presidential elections 2027: More candidates, more confusion (Episode 2)
item.description: France will head to the polls to vote for its next president in the spring of 2027. Thirty-eight candidates are currently vying to make it onto the final ballot and have until March 12 to gather backing from 500 elected officials. One figure currently stands out: Marine Le Pen. The far-right National Rally leader has a significant lead in the latest polls.

item.title: WHO sounds alarm over antibiotic resistance
item.description: The World Health Organization sounded the alarm Monday over antimicrobial resistance, saying the world is off pace to meet key 2030 targets. Many countries have long neglected funding to track and detect dangerous microbes that resist antibiotic treatment, according to a report by the body.

item.title: Xi embraces Trump in China: 'Diplomacy playing out in real time'
item.description: President Xi Jinping personally greeted US counterpart Donald Trump on the tarmac at a Chinese airport on Wednesday, with the two leaders briefly hugging ahead of their highly anticipated meeting with Russia's Vladimir Putin. Reporting from Shenzhen, France 24's Jan Camenzind Broomby says the warm greeting was a "big sign of respect" from Xi but also a calculated component of diplomatic efforts.

item.title: Xi welcomes Trump to China ahead of high-stakes Putin meeting
item.description: President Xi Jinping personally greeted US counterpart Donald Trump on the tarmac at a Chinese airport on Wednesday, with the two leaders briefly hugging ahead of their highly anticipated meeting with Russia's Vladimir Putin. Beijing has indicated the war in Ukraine will not be discussed during the trilateral meeting, but Trump had said the conflict would find its way onto the agenda, something that experts say is likely to please Putin.
